verses.text: Ha t'a junel, ix em winhaj Sansón t'a yol jun schonhab' heb' filisteo skuchan Timnat, ix kan snib'ej winh t'a jun ix kob'es ta'.

Haxo yik ix jax winh t'a spat, ix yalan winh t'a winh smam yet' t'a ix snun icha tik: --Ay jun ix kob'es ix wil t'a Timnat t'a skal heb' ix filistea, ix kan in gana t'a ix, yuj chi' swal t'ayex to b'at he k'an ix wik'a', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi smam snun winh chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ha t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ol b'at a say ix etb'eyum? ¿Tom manhxa junok ix ix wach' ik'an t'a skal heb' ayto kuj ko b'a yet'ok, mato t'a skal heb' ketchonhab' tik? xchi heb' t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Ha wal jun ix chi' in gana. Ha ix b'at he k'an wik'a', xchi winh.
Te manh yojtakok heb' smam snun winh chi' tas spensar Jehová, to wan sna'an tas ol aj yel yich junok owal yet' heb' filisteo chi', yujto ayoch heb' israel t'a yalanh smandar heb' t'a jun pekti' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Sansón yet' heb' smam snun t'a chonhab' Timnat chi'. Ayik ix ek' heb' t'a jun makan te' uwa awab'il yuj heb' aj Timnat chi', ix elta jun nok' kelem choj t'a winhaj Sansón chi', tz'el yaw nok' skot nok' t'a winh.

T'a wal jun rato chi', ix och Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh, ix te och yip winh, malaj wal jab'ok tas yet'nak winh yet' wal sk'ab' winh ix sjekchitanb'at jun nok' choj chi', icha tz'aj sjekchitajb'at junok yune' chiwa. Maj yal-laj winh t'a smam snun tas ix sk'ulej chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Timnat chi', ix lolon winh yet' ix kob'es chi', ix kannhej snib'ej winh t'a ix.

Haxo yik ix ek'b'at jaye' k'uhal, ayik wan sb'at winhaj Sansón yik ol nupnaj yet' ix filistea chi', ix ek' winh b'aj ix smilcham nok' choj chi'. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix yilan winh, ayxo och jun nok' chab' t'a yol sjoyumte'al sb'akil nok', te b'ut'an yo'ol chi' yuj yal nok' chab' chi'.

Ix yik'anelta nok' winh, ix slo'an winh, ix b'at winh. Haxo ix k'och winh t'a spatik smam snun chi', ix yak'an nok' yalchab' chi' winh slo heb'. Maj yal-laj winh t'a heb' tato ha t'a yol sjoyumte'al sb'akil nok' choj ix yik'elta nok' yalchab' chi' winh.
Ix emk'och smam snun winh chi' t'a spat ix kob'es chi', ix yak'anoch jun k'inh yik nupnajel winhaj Sansón chi', ichataxon sb'eyb'al heb' winh kelemtak t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Sansón heb' winh filisteo chi', ix yawtankot 30 heb' winh kelemtak heb' winh yik syil k'inh nupnajel chi' heb' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Sansón t'a heb' winh kelemtak chi' icha tik: --Ay jun lolonel ol wal t'ayex, a exxo ol he na'a tas syalelk'ochi: Tato ha t'a uke' k'uhal k'inh tik ol eyal tas syalelk'ochi, ol wak' junjunok he pichul nab'a lino yet' junjunok he pichul yik k'inh.

Tato manh ol nachajel eyuj jun, a ex ol eyak' junjunok k'apak nab'a lino chi' t'ayin yet' junjunok mojanh in pichul yik k'inh, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Al na'ik kab' an, ol kab'i tas jun lolonel chi', xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha t'a junok chiwajum, hata' ix elta tas tz'uk'chaji. Ha t'a jun te ay yip, hata' ix elta tas te chi', xchi winh. Haxo t'a yoxil k'uhal k'inh chi', maj yal-laj spakan jun lolonel chi' heb' winh kelemtak chi'.

Yuj chi' haxo t'a schanhil k'uhal, ix yalan heb' winh t'a ix yetb'eyum winhaj Sansón chi' icha tik: --Montej ab' t'a winh etb'eyum chi' tas syalelk'och jun lolonel ix yal winh t'ayonh, slajwi chi' tzalan t'ayonh. Tato ma'ay, ol ach ko nhustz'a yet' a mam a nun yet' masanil mach ayek' t'a yol a pat tik. Ichato tonhej tzonh eyawtejkot t'a tik, yik tze k'ananek' tas ay t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh t'a ix.

Ixlajwi chi', wan yok' ix, ix b'at yalan ix t'a winhaj Sansón chi': --Tzin a chak a ach tik. Max in a xajanejlaj. Ix al jun a lolonel yik sna'el heb' winh wetchonhab', palta manh wal jab'ok tzal t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, xchi ix t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix icha tik: --Max waltax t'a in mam in nun, atob' wal t'ayach ol wala', xchi winh.
Ix och wal ijan ix yok' t'a winh t'a uke' k'uhal chi', yuj chi' haxo t'a yukil k'uhal chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix tas syalelk'ochi. Ixnhej lajwi yab'an ix, ix b'at yalan ix t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi'.

Haxo t'a k'ik'b'alil t'a yukil k'uhal chi', ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Sansón chi' icha tik: Malaj junokxo tas te chi' t'a yichanh nok' yalchab'. Malaj pax junokxo te ay yip t'a yichanh nok' choj, xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: Yujnhej to ix he montej eyab' t'a ix wetb'eyum tik, yuj chi' ix nachaj eyalan tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix ochxi Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh, ix te och yip winh. Ix b'at winh t'a chonhab' Ascalón, ix b'at smak'ancham 30 heb' winh filisteo winh ta'. Ha spichul heb' winh ayochi, a ix yik'elta winh, ix yak'an winh stojolok tas ix yal chi'. Ixlajwi chi', wan ste chichon sk'ol winh ix meltzaj winh t'a spat winh smam.
Haxo ix yetb'eyum winh chi', ha t'a jun winh ajun yet' winh t'a jun k'inh chi', ha t'a winh ix ak'ji ix.
